teacher_info.about_teacher:
As teacher, my primary goal is to lend a helping hand and offer inspiration. 

So much of language learning is simply related to motivation and interest. These will carry students much farther than grammar books and drills. Consistency is a necessity, along with a real love for the language. I stand both as an accountability partner and a guide.

I can be relaxed and conversational if you prefer to explore the English language, or I can be detail oriented and rigorous if you have a job interview, a public speech, or a thesis approaching. 

One of my favorite ways of engaging with my students is by teaching them how to learn (or at least—what has worked for me).
teacher_info.teaching_style:
The heart of any language is its literature. 

For English, this means a number of world class authors—Shakespeare, Milton, Hemingway, Bronte, Woolf. 

If you're looking to enrich your vocabulary, to move beyond a B1/B2 level, to be able to speak about ideas and express yourself with ease and eloquence—my lessons can provide the jumping off point, the foundation, and the solidifying of your skills. 

Aside from conversational lessons, we can read intriguing and important texts together that simultaneously help improve your accent and your comprehension. 

I am hoping to help anyone, academic or self driven, who wants to study and truly live the beautiful English language.

Whether you simply want to strengthen your writing skills in general, or if you have a certain paper, thesis, letter, interview or speech soon due—this lesson is for you.

pro_course_detail.title: English Language Through Literature
pro_course_detail.description:
The heart of any language is in its literature. 

There, the ideas, the stories, and the unique turns-of-phrase and rhythms that built the modern spoken language lay waiting to be discovered. These great works give us a world to enter, to participate in, and ultimately to bring into ourselves. They lend themselves to a deeper understanding of the target language and allow us to build a more personal relationship with it. 

The advantages of a literary education are not only aesthetic but, above all, practical. A knowledge of literature exposes the student to a much wider and more powerful range of vocabulary than most conversational courses, while also teaching higher level grammar and syntax, greater comprehension, an ear for eloquence, and important cultural allusions. 

For this type of lesson, you are free to select any classic work of literature, poetry, philosophy, politics, etc. and I will read it with you chapter by chapter, and build lessons based upon your desired outcome. We can spend time on vocabulary, discussing or debating critical themes, or any aspect of your choice. I can also take the lead and offer a general English language literature course, or general assistance in understanding a literary work (a holistic approach). 

This course may appeal especially to college students who are struggling through a difficult English language text, though, this is truly for everyone who wants to deepen and broaden their knowledge of English, and perhaps—just perhaps—learn to enjoy the fruits of their labor.

In this lesson we look at your negotiation style and techniques and how you can adopt customs and idioms that are particular to your international environment.

- To use common vocabulary used during different stages of a business meeting (introductions, reviewing past business/meeting notes, discussing items, finishing the meeting)

This course can be taken at any time, but it is most advantageous to do so before memorizing thousands of words with inaccurate pronunciation, and before spending countless hours practicing bad prosody in conversations.

Depending on your personal goals and what we uncover during our first conversation, we may perfect your consonants, vowels, stress, intonation, rhythm, etc. We can improve all of these at either a basic or advanced level, as needed.

Video or just audio — it’s your decision, as I can tell exactly how you’re using your lips, tongue, etc., just by listening.

pro_course_detail.title: Step 1: Accent Assessment
pro_course_detail.description:
It is important to note that the Accent Reduction Assessment is a valuable tool used to measure an individual's pronunciation and intonation relative to the Standard American Accent. Upon completion of the assessment, the client will receive a report outlining any existing problems and the severity of each issue for the 44 English-American sounds/phonemes and evaluation of their intonation. The final score will indicate the percentage of correctly pronounced American English sounds/phonemes, with a perfect score being 100, representing the Standard American Accent. It is important to strive for a score as close to 100 as possible, as this indicates a higher level of accuracy in pronunciation and intonation.

The assessment consists of a comprehensive range of English sounds (phonemes). The candidate will read the assessment and provide a speech sample that will be recorded. Afterward, the candidate's performance will be scored, and the results will be shared with the client within five business days.
